data.name: Dolphin Tours
data.headline: 2 hours • We guarantee you will see dolphins! • All ages!
data.description: Our dolphin tours get you up close and personal with the majestic animals. See dolphins interact in their natural environment. You'll learn about the resident dolphins and some of our crews favorite individuals they get to see each and every day. This trip is not only fun, but educational for all ages. We guarantee you will see dolphins during this tour. You will also get to see a variety of birds that call the 10,000 Islands home as you cruise in and around these unique ecosystem.
data.highlights:
Have you ever met wild marine mammals that have their own names? Our crew recognize individual dolphins each day and have stories to share about them! You'll go home having seen a local favorite and want to visit them every year.

Since our crew gets to observe these dolphins daily, their knowledge about the behaviors, hunting, playing, and mating is vast! You'll have learned some amazing facts and develop a deep appreciation for the species and ecosystem they call home!

We guarantee you will see dolphins during your tour! Many tours cannot guarantee wildlife specific sightings but we know where our dolphins hangout and how to find them! You'll be talking about your tour to all you know! In fact, many have said this tour was the highlight of their vacation!
data.itinerary: When you arrive at the park, you will be instructed by a crew member where to park, how to get a parking pass, and where to wait for the tour. You will be waiting in the shaded pavilion area until called for your tour. If you are not approached or you do not hear your name called, please find a crew member in one of our company shirts, they say Florida Adventures and Rentals on them. Your group will be brought down to the dock and assisted to board the boat. Your captain will do a safety briefing and your tour will begin. Our dolphin tours travel all around the islands south of Marco Island. Your crew will provide you with interesting facts and information about the ecosystem, history, and wildlife you come across throughout the tour. The tour will start and end at the same park location. Please note tours may start a few minutes late or end a few minutes late depending on the amount of activity at the dock as this is a public boat ramp and dock.

data.cancellation_summary: Customers receive a full refund for cancellations 48 hours before the booking. Cancellations, changes, or no-shows within 48 hours are charged in full. Operator cancellations get a full refund.
data.cancellation_notes: Customers will receive a full refund if they cancel their reservation 48 hours prior to the date and time of their booking, (customers will be charged in full within the 48 hour period before the booking). Changes on your reservation will be received 48 hours in advance, otherwise your will be charged in full for your original booking. Contact us by phone to cancel or inquire about a cancellation. No-shows will be charged the full price. Customers will also receive a full refund in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. In the event that a tour operates for 50% of the scheduled time but must be cut short due to weather conditions for safety reasons, customers will receive a gift certificate for the remaining balance of the tour.
data.check_in_details:
Guests will need to sign our online waivers before check in. This can be found in the confirmation email. A text the day before or morning of the tour will be sent as a reminder of location and waivers. 

A crew member will be at the park waiting to check in all guests for the scheduled tour. Please look out for our shirts to know who to check in with. 
Once parked and checked in, you will be instructed for a parking pass, where the bathroom is, and where to wait before the crew calls for their group. 

Please note that our company waits at the shaded pavilion ONLY for check in. You cannot go down to the docks or any other part of the park to find us. If you do not see our crew, call the office for information and assistance.
data.accessibility: Yes, please note there are 3 steps in and out of the boat from the dock.
data.special_requirements:
Infants must weigh more than 17 lbs to be on board any of our boats per Coast Guard Regulations. If under that weight, they are not allowed on board. 

All minors must be accompanied by an adult.

Service animals ONLY are allowed on the public boat tours. If you wish to have your pet dog on your boat, you must book a private tour only. Also note that you are solely responsible for the dog, and the crew is not responsible to care for your dog during the tour.
data.restrictions: No restrictions, but please consult your doctor if you are pregnant or have medical care needs before booking the tour to ensure your safety.
data.extras: Life Jackets are available on the vessel, but are not required to be worn for adults or children during the tour. Your captain and crew will happily assist in putting them on or having them out for you per your request.
data.disclaimers:
Please understand that weather can change at any given moment that could prevent the tour from starting or result in your tour ending early. Our crew is constantly watching the radars to ensure all guests safety, it is their call to bring guests in early due to bad weather conditions.

If you or your guests in your party are not being respectful to your captain, guide, or other guests, the captain and guide have the right to return your group back to the dock. NO REFUND will be processed. 

Wildlife sightings can be unpredictable. We never know what the dolphins, birds or other wildlife are doing at any given time of day, or where they are hanging out. As you cruise around the islands, your captain is driving to all the known favorite spots of the dolphins. Sometimes this can take a little bit of time, so please be patient and understanding that your captain and guide are doing their best!
data.faqs:
Can we swim with the dolphins?
No! Under the Marine Mammal Act, it is illegal to swim, feed, hunt, harass or harm/kill any marine mammal species in US waterways. This would be a federal crime. Also note, that if you were to jump into the water where the dolphins are, they will swim away from you very quickly as you are now seen as a threat. 

Is there a risk of getting sea sick?
Unlikely. Our boat route sticks to the backwater areas, where it is very unlikely to boat in big swells that would cause sea sickness. We do recommend if you are prone to getting sea sick you take your necessary precautions as a preventative, but we have not had a guest ever feel sea sick during our boat tours.

What should we wear?
Outdoor comfortable clothing. Since this tour does not make any stops on a beach, you do not need to worry about getting your feet wet.

Will the dolphins play in the wake of the boat?
Our company does not pose a risk to the dolphins, so the captain will not attempt to make the dolphins get in the wake. We do see very playful dolphin activity very often, and they tend to come up very close to our boats when the engine is off. They are curious by nature and will check out the boats and us! 

Will we see manatees?
Manatees can be seen during the spring and summer months in our area very frequently. During fall and winter it is a rare time of year to see them. They are migratory, and will move inland once air temperatures begin to drop.
